versos.hebraico: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

controles.web: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
controles.kjv: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
controles.livre: Estas são as jornadas dos filhos de Israel, os quais saíram da terra do Egito por seus esquadrões, sob a condução de Moisés e Arão.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־מוֹצָאֵיהֶ֛ם לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥לֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their goings out.
controles.kjv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
controles.livre: E Moisés escreveu suas saídas conforme suas jornadas por ordem do SENHOR. Estas, pois, são suas jornadas conforme suas partidas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֤וּ מֵֽרַעְמְסֵס֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן מִֽמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַפֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
controles.kjv: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
controles.livre: De Ramessés partiram no mês primeiro, aos quinze dias do mês primeiro: no segundo dia da páscoa saíram os filhos de Israel com mão alta, à vista de todos os egípcios.

versos.hebraico: וּמִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם כָּל־בְּכ֑וֹר וּבֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁפָטִֽים׃

controles.web: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.
controles.kjv: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.
controles.livre: Estavam enterrando os egípcios os que o SENHOR havia matado deles, a todo primogênito; havendo o SENHOR feito também juízos em seus deuses.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֑ס וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּסֻכֹּֽת׃

controles.web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
controles.livre: Partiram, pois, os filhos de Israel de Ramessés, e assentaram acampamento em Sucote.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
controles.livre: E partindo de Sucote, assentaram em Etã, que está ao extremo do deserto.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽאֵתָ֔ם וַיָּ֨שָׁב֙ עַל־פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵ֖י בַּ֣עַל צְפ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מִגְדֹּֽל׃

controles.web: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi–hahiroth, which is before Baal–zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
controles.livre: E partindo de Etã, voltaram sobre Pi-Hairote, que está diante de Baal-Zefom, e assentaram diante de Migdol.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַֽחִירֹ֔ת וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּ֑רָה וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמָרָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
controles.kjv: And they departed from before Pi–hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
controles.livre: E partindo de Pi-Hairote, passaram por meio do mar ao deserto, e andaram caminho de três dias pelo deserto de Etã, e assentaram em Mara.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֵילִ֑מָה וּ֠בְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
controles.livre: E partindo de Mara, vieram a Elim, de onde havia doze fontes de águas, e setenta palmeiras; e assentaram ali.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֵילִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃

controles.web: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
controles.livre: E partidos de Elim, assentaram junto ao mar Vermelho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיַּם־ס֑וּף וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּר־סִֽין׃

controles.web: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
controles.kjv: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
controles.livre: E partidos do mar Vermelho, assentaram no deserto de Sim.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּר־סִ֑ין וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדָפְקָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
controles.kjv: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
controles.livre: E partidos do deserto de Sim, assentaram em Dofca.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדָּפְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאָלֽוּשׁ׃

controles.web: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
controles.livre: E partidos de Dofca, assentaram em Alus.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאָל֑וּשׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּרְפִידִ֔ם וְלֹא־הָ֨יָה שָׁ֥ם מַ֛יִם לָעָ֖ם לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
controles.livre: E partidos de Alus, assentaram em Refidim, onde o povo não teve águas para beber.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרְפִידִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

controles.web: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.livre: E partidos de Refidim, assentaram no deserto de Sinai.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּקִבְרֹ֥ת הַֽתַּאֲוָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
controles.kjv: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth–hattaavah.
controles.livre: E partidos do deserto de Sinai, assentaram em Quibrote-Taavá.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקִּבְרֹ֣ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֹֽת׃

controles.web: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Kibroth–hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
controles.livre: E partidos de Quibrote-Taavá, assentaram em Hazerote.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲצֵרֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִתְמָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Hazerote, assentaram em Ritmá.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִתְמָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִמֹּ֥ן פָּֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon–parez.
controles.livre: E partidos de Ritmá, assentaram em Rimom-Perez.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִמֹּ֣ן פָּ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּלִבְנָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Rimmon–parez, and pitched in Libnah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Rimom-Perez, assentaram em Libna.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִלִּבְנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִסָּֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Libna, assentaram em Rissa.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִסָּ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּקְהֵלָֽתָה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
controles.kjv: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Rissa, assentaram em Queelata,

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקְּהֵלָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּהַר־שָֽׁפֶר׃

controles.web: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
controles.kjv: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
controles.livre: E partidos de Queelata, assentaram no monte de Séfer.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽהַר־שָׁ֑פֶר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲרָדָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
controles.kjv: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
controles.livre: E partidos do monte de Séfer, assentaram em Harada.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲרָדָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹֽת׃

controles.web: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
controles.livre: E partidos de Harada, assentaram em Maquelote.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽחַת׃

controles.web: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
controles.livre: E partidos de Maquelote, assentaram em Taate.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑חַת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽרַח׃

controles.web: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Taate, assentaram em Tera.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑רַח וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִתְקָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Tera, assentaram em Mitca.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּתְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
controles.kjv: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Mitca, assentaram em Hasmona.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽחַשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמֹסֵרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
controles.livre: E partidos de Hasmona, assentaram em Moserote.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמֹּסֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּבְנֵ֥י יַעֲקָֽן׃

controles.web: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene–jaakan.
controles.livre: E partidos de Moserote, assentaram em Bene-Jaacã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִבְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקָ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחֹ֥ר הַגִּדְגָּֽד׃

controles.web: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Bene–jaakan, and encamped at Hor–hagidgad.
controles.livre: E partidos de Bene-Jaacã, assentaram em Hor-Gidgade.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֹ֣ר הַגִּדְגָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּיָטְבָֽתָה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
controles.kjv: And they went from Hor–hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Hor-Gidgade, assentaram em Jotbatá.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיָּטְבָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַבְרֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
controles.livre: E partidos de Jotbatá, assentaram em Abrona.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽעַבְרֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר׃

controles.web: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion–gaber.
controles.livre: E partidos de Abrona, assentaram em Eziom-Geber.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעֶצְי֣וֹן גָּ֑בֶר וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְמִדְבַּר־צִ֖ן הִ֥וא קָדֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Ezion–gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
controles.livre: E partidos de Eziom-Geber, assentaram no deserto de Zim, que é Cades.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקָּדֵ֑שׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

controles.web: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
controles.livre: E partidos de Cades, assentaram no monte de Hor, na extremidade do país de Edom.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל־הֹ֥ר הָהָ֛ר עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֑ם בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְצֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֥ד לַחֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
controles.kjv: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
controles.livre: E subiu Arão o sacerdote ao monte de Hor, conforme o dito do SENHOR, e ali morreu aos quarenta anos da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no mês quinto, no primeiro dia do mês.

versos.hebraico: וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן־שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמֹת֖וֹ בְּהֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃ס

controles.web: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
controles.kjv: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
controles.livre: E era Arão de idade de cento e vinte e três anos, quando morreu no monte de Hor.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲרָ֔ד וְהֽוּא־יֹשֵׁ֥ב בַּנֶּ֖גֶב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן בְּבֹ֖א בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E o cananeu, rei de Arade, que habitava ao sul na terra de Canaã, ouviu como haviam vindo os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֑ר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּצַלְמֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
controles.kjv: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
controles.livre: E partidos do monte de Hor, assentaram em Zalmona.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִצַּלְמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּפוּנֹֽן׃

controles.web: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
controles.livre: E partidos de Zalmona, assentaram em Punom.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִפּוּנֹ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאֹבֹֽת׃

controles.web: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
controles.livre: E partidos de Punom, assentaram em Obote.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֹבֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּעִיֵּ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים בִּגְב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב׃

controles.web: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije–abarim, in the border of Moab.
controles.livre: E partidos de Obote, assentaram em Ijé-Abarim; no termo de Moabe.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעִיִּ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדִיבֹ֥ן גָּֽד׃

controles.web: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
controles.kjv: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon–gad.
controles.livre: E partidos de Ijé-Abarim, assentaram em Dibom-Gade.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדִּיבֹ֣ן גָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַלְמֹ֥ן דִּבְלָתָֽיְמָה׃

controles.web: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Dibon–gad, and encamped in Almon–diblathaim.
controles.livre: E partidos de Dibom-Gade, assentaram em Almom-Diblataim.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעַלְמֹ֣ן דִּבְלָתָ֑יְמָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּהָרֵ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י נְבֽוֹ׃

controles.web: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
controles.kjv: And they removed from Almon–diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
controles.livre: E partidos de Almom-Diblataim, assentaram nos montes de Abarim, diante de Nebo.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהָרֵ֣י הָעֲבָרִ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
controles.kjv: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
controles.livre: E partidos dos montes de Abarim, assentaram nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִבֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמֹ֔ת עַ֖ד אָבֵ֣ל הַשִּׁטִּ֑ים בְּעַֽרְבֹ֖ת מוֹאָֽב׃ס

controles.web: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
controles.kjv: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth–jesimoth even unto Abel–shittim in the plains of Moab.
controles.livre: Finalmente assentaram junto ao Jordão, desde Bete-Jesimote até Abel-Sitim, nos campos de Moabe.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés nos campos de Moabe junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes passado o Jordão à terra de Canaã,

versos.hebraico: וְה֨וֹרַשְׁתֶּ֜ם אֶת־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֨בַּדְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־צַלְמֵ֤י מַסֵּֽכֹתָם֙ תְּאַבֵּ֔דוּ וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־בָּמֹתָ֖ם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ׃

controles.web: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
controles.kjv: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
controles.livre: Expulsareis a todos os moradores do país de diante de vós, e destruireis todas suas imagens esculpidas, e todas suas imagens de fundição, e arruinareis todos os seus altos;

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־בָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
controles.kjv: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
controles.livre: E expulsareis os moradores da terra, e habitareis nela; porque eu a dei a vós para que a possuais.

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת־הָאָ֨רֶץ בְּגוֹרָ֜ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם לָרַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ וְלַמְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת־נַחֲלָת֔וֹ אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר־יֵ֨צֵא ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛מָּה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לְמַטּ֥וֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תִּתְנֶחָֽלוּ׃

controles.web: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
controles.kjv: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
controles.livre: E herdareis a terra por sortes por vossas famílias: aos muitos dareis muito por sua herança, e aos poucos dareis menos por herança sua: onde lhe sair a sorte, ali a terá cada um: pelas tribos de vossos pais herdareis.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תוֹרִ֜ישׁוּ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָרֶץ֮ מִפְּנֵיכֶם֒ וְהָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵהֶ֔ם לְשִׂכִּים֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וְלִצְנִינִ֖ם בְּצִדֵּיכֶ֑ם וְצָרֲר֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
controles.kjv: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
controles.livre: E se não expulsardes os moradores do país de diante de vós, sucederá que os que deixardes deles serão por aguilhões em vossos olhos, e por espinhos em vossos lados, e vos afligirão sobre a terra em que vós habitardes.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”
controles.kjv: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
controles.livre: Será também, que farei a vós como eu pensei fazer a eles.
